name: Professor Elspeth Garside

intro.text: Field research, {player}. I need fresh data on how far you've come. It's entirely scientific.
Also, I've been itching to try my new team. Ready?

win: Splendid. That's a very good data point. I shall have to add a footnote. And a biscuit.
after: Come back tomorrow. I'll have a new hypothesis.
